notes: Geometry lesson: the exam prints a figure for essentially every question here, so figures were drawn on all 20 bank problems plus the opener and all three teach walks (24 SVGs). All generated programmatically from each problem's own numbers, then re-read against the problem text and solutions: every visible length/angle/label matches the question, and the unknown is marked '?' or by its symbol (square P = 36 cm, rectangle ? width, circle A = 154, sector angle). Every SVG is self-contained (no external refs, no scripts), theme-safe (all text and outline strokes use currentColor; region fills use soft #60a5fa / #34d399 / #f59e0b at fill-opacity 0.15-0.22; the annulus hole is fill:none so it reads on light and dark), Inter labels at 10-11px, role=img with a descriptive aria-label, each well under 3KB. Exam conventions used: dashed perpendicular heights with right-angle squares on triangles/parallelograms/trapezium, angle arcs on sectors, and a 'Diagram not drawn accurately' caption on every geometric figure. Done in the same pass as the guided conversion. Validator PASS; every label independently cross-checked.
